title: libpod: move per-container pasta process to dedicated systemd scope
body:
When running podman from a systemd user service, per-container pasta processes stay in the service's control group. If the service is restarted, the pasta processes are killed, breaking networking for running containers.

Move the per-container pasta process into a dedicated libpod-pasta-<random>.scope in user.slice on systemd, matching the existing pattern used for rootless netns pasta.

The PID file is written to the container's run directory (ctr.state.RunDir) instead of /tmp to avoid SELinux and systemd PrivateTmp issues.

Ref: #29582
Ref: https://github.com/containers/podman/issues/29582
